thread:
noah: Heads-up — I opened a short checklist for the stream ownership refactor. Goal is to make ingress proxy "ownership" of in-flight streams explicit and observable, not change client semantics. TL;DR: split responsibilities, add metrics, experiment rollouts.

sasha: Nice. Can you paste the checklist here?

noah: Sure. High level items: 1) Add stream-owner id that flows with request (immutable once assigned). 2) Emit owner-change events in trace when handoff happens. 3) Add metric: active_streams_by_owner and owner_handoff_count. 4) Backpressure: enforcement stays per-connection but allow owner to decide shed policy. 5) Retry semantics: retries should never create a new owner unless a hard reconnect happens. 6) Add QA plan + canary gates.

qasim: Two quick questions: a) How do we avoid owner explosion when proxies forward to many upstreams? b) Does this affect resumable streaming tokens?

noah: Good Qs. a) Owner is proxy-instance-scoped + a short stable id (not full hostname). We also cap TTL for owner IDs; we garbage-collect after Xs of inactivity. b) Resumable tokens remain the canonical client-visible handle for resume — owner id is internal metadata. Token resumes may reattach to same or new owner, that's expected.

sasha: About retries: we should be explicit about idempotency keys. If a retry is a safe retry (idempotent) we should allow it to re-use the same owner where possible to preserve KV caches. For non-idempotent, force new owner / new session.

noah: Agreed. I'll add a check: upstream should indicate safety via a header (X-Retry-Safety: safe|unsafe) and gateway will prefer sticky route for safe.

infra-bot: deploy-checklist created: /infra/checks/stream-owner-refactor (status: pending).

qasim: Observability notes: add an SLI for "resume-success-rate" and a small histogram of resume-latency. Also tag traces with owner_id and resume_token when present.

noah: Good. Rollout plan I'm thinking: A) feature-flag owner IDs (emit only), B) add metrics and dashboards, C) enable handoff logic behind flag, D) small canary in eu-west-1, E) ramp.

sasha: Add regression tests for: partial responses during handoff, abort propagation (client cancel -> owner forwards cancel), and duplicate token resume (ensure we dedupe).

noah: I'll add unit + integration tests and a chaos scenario where the owner process restarts mid-stream. Expected behavior: client gets a short failure and resume path works if token provided.

qasim: One more ops consideration: disk-backed small owner index for long-lived streams so GC doesn't OOM the proxy. Keep memory-first but spill to disk above N entries.

noah: Will prototype memory -> mmap-backed ring cache.

sasha: Thanks. Can you add the checklist to the architecture RFC folder? I'll review tomorrow.

noah: Done: https://internal/redwood/rfcs/arch/stream-owner-refactor — added checklist + tests + canary playbook. Comments welcome. :thumbsup:
